correctness.rationale: The field, rational-point-defined maps, and homogeneous minimal degree are precisely specified. The explicit descended quadratic conjugate has a directly enumerated 7-point action carrying no Fano line to a line; a transposition preserves exactly three. All degree-three and degree-four homaloidal types are handled, including infinitely near points; quadratic conjugation reduces an admissible quartic to degree two, making its permutation even. Three finite verification scripts actually run and corroborate the incidence and quartic binary-jet checks. The proof makes no existence claim at degree five.

value.rationale: The literature proves all symmetric permutations are realizable, so the minimal homogeneous degree of a single transposition is a natural quantitative gap. A rigorous obstruction through degree four with an explicit Fano incidence signature is a meaningful finite-degree cutoff, not an arbitrary coefficient slice; it separates degree-two birational actions from elementary odd permutations and constrains later constructions. It makes no unsupported claim to solve the exact minimum.
